==Incorrect Answer==
''"That issss... incorrect." Further, I have taken advantage of your lack of acuity to beam aboard your ship and steal your stuff!''
* You lose {{Transaction|35|subtract_scrap}}, {{Transaction|2-4|subtract_fuel}}, {{Transaction|1-2|subtract_drones}}.

==Correct Answer==
''"That isss... correct. You sssurprise me. Human, is it? Yesss... we can be partners." The Slug beams aboard and joins your crew!''
* You receive a <span style="color:limegreen">Slug crewmember</span>.

==Trivia==
This event is called "SLUG_DISTRESS_QUESTION" in the datafiles.
* Prior to the Advanced Edition update, it was possible to know the correct answer by looking at the grammar of the event. ([https://www.reddit.com/r/ftlgame/comments/224w67/official_ftl_advanced_edition_change_log_from_the/ No more comma differences between the text of the marooned slug (sorry /u/Twinge)])
